title: rw_export_daw_set in apricity-web: compile a score and write the set with embedded templates
description:
Add `rw_export_daw_set(score_ptr, len, options)` to crates/apricity-web/src/lib.rs, wrapping the apricity-daw writer over the compiled Timeline (as `rw_compile` does). Embed the gzipped templates with `include_bytes!`. Returns the set bytes plus a manifest of sample ids and their paths inside the project folder, or located errors in the existing result encoding.

Verification: `cargo build -p apricity-web --release --target wasm32-wasip1` and the Node WASI test that exports examples/march-blues.apr and compares with the CLI's set file. Commit: `feat(apricitus-ee4b32)`. Depends on apricity-daw from M1.
Dependencies:
  blocked-by: apricitus-74c11a12-78c2-4312-b2b1-cf2bb2f5096a
